verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is the product's own capability for code that runs automatically in the background. It can fire on Firebase and Google Cloud events (Auth, Storage, background events) or on recurring Cloud Scheduler jobs, and deploys with one command. However, these are developer-written serverless functions rather than AI-native autonomous automations, and nothing documents agent-driven or natural-language automation setup. missing for 10: AI/agent-driven autonomous automations, no-code or natural-language automation setup, detailed scheduling docs, independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Cloud Functions for Firebase is a serverless framework that lets you automatically run backend code in response to events triggered by background events, HTTPS requests, the Admin SDK, or Cloud Scheduler jobs.
The functions you write can respond to events generated by various Firebase and Google Cloud features, from Firebase Authentication triggers to Cloud Storage Triggers.
Deploy your JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python code to our servers with one command from the command line.
